objective: Determine whether the latest independently published open-weight Qwen3.6-27B ICA direction exposes a retrievable, exact-identity public interpretability artifact; distinguish such availability from causal semantic validation.

candidate.size: 27B parameters, 64 layers; 16 ICA layers sampled every fourth layer, 5120 directions per layer
candidate.lens_artifact_license_and_exact_revision: UNVERIFIED: must not conflate code license with fitted lens artifacts
candidate.hosted_inference_availability: Neuronpedia docs published TRUE for 32-icalens-res; no inference requested or performed

protocol.admit_only_if: HTTP JSON object; exact modelId, source/sourceId and index 77; no oversized/malformed payload
protocol.raw_data_policy: Never write or log original explanations, text activations, logits, prompts, or provider payloads. Return count/field names and SHA256 only.

freeze.prospective_control: Identity-mismatched mock response and unrelated-feature/malformed-response negative controls
freeze.scientific_semantic_success: NONE; source record inspection is NOT an experiment testing donor concept truth or native transfer

protocol.stop: If source absent or explanation sparse, do NOT tune candidate feature ID based on result; preserve negative feasibility outcome.

own_execution_authority: Public GitHub Actions one-shot metadata GET only; no right to schedule or steer models or run first-use experiments
